headline: Drivers Using the App Can't Get Paid: Ukraine Hits Yandex, Our Taxi Drivers Are Hurt!
summary: A Ukrainian drone strike on a Yandex data center in Russia has disrupted Yandex Go payments. Istanbul taxi drivers say they have struggled to collect fares for two to three days.
why: Yandex is a major Russian technology company operating ride-hailing and internet services. Data center outages can disrupt its digital payment operations.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
